Professional Tube Testing

Accurate measurements. The right tester. Clear results.

We test nearly every audio, radio, amplifier and communications tube—from familiar receiving types to 300B, 845, 211 and specialized transmitting tubes.

Why professional testing matters

A basic emission check does not always tell the full story. Depending on the tube, meaningful evaluation may include mutual conductance, plate current, gas or grid current, leakage, shorts and section balance.

Measurements available

Mutual conductance (Gm)
Plate current
Emission
Gas / grid current
Leakage and shorts
Section balance

Matching services

For suitable tube types, tubes can be grouped into pairs, quads or larger sets using relevant measurements. This is especially valuable for audio amplifiers and communications equipment where balanced performance matters.

Equipment selected for the tube

Our testing equipment includes the Amplitrex AT-1000, calibrated TV-7, Hickok 539, Maxi-Preamp II and additional specialized testers. No single tester is ideal for every tube, so equipment is chosen based on tube type and required measurements.

Shipping your tubes

Small orders can be shipped to us for testing. Pack each tube securely, identify the return address and include a note describing any matching or special testing requirements.
